description: This file contains a PHP class 'ToolbarItemConditionsMetConstraintValidator' which implements validation logic for CKEditor 5 toolbar items within Drupal, checking conditions like image upload status, filters, and plugin dependencies.

classes.name: ToolbarItemConditionsMetConstraintValidator
classes.description: A validator class for checking conditions on CKEditor 5 toolbar items in Drupal, ensuring plugin and configuration requirements are met.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on a toolbar item, checking conditions like plugin presence, image upload status, and filters.

methods.name: findDefinitionForToolbarItem
methods.description: Finds the CKEditor 5 plugin definition that provides a specific toolbar item.
